description:
Has this home's asking price changed? Every change Cubi observed.

    Returns each observed asking-price change for one listing (date, old and
    new price, percent), oldest first, with the current price, the total
    change since the first observed price, and when Cubi first saw the
    listing. Cubi's log starts on `tracked_since` (2026-05-02): no change
    listed means none was observed since then, not that the price never
    changed — say so. Asking prices, not sale prices or valuations.

    Args:
        listing_id: Source-prefixed id of a listing already shown (e.g.
            `remax:12345`). Do not invent one.

    Returns:
        JSON: current_price, on_cubi_since, tracked_since, changes[{date,
        old_price, new_price, pct}], drops, raises, total_change_pct.
name: get_price_history
title: Get price history
